title: Best Slideshow Video Makers (2026): Photo Videos for Any Occasion
description: How to hire a slideshow video maker for weddings, memorials, events or products: music rights, formats, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: A slideshow video turns photos and short clips into a video with music, transitions and text. It is popular for weddings, birthdays, memorials, school events, real estate and product showcases. Projects go wrong when photos are sent in a mess, the music cannot be used where the video is shown, or the final video has the wrong format or length. This guide helps you get a slideshow you will be happy to share.

faq.q: How many photos should I send?
faq.a: It depends on length. As a rough guide, a few seconds per photo works well. Ask the editor how many photos fit your target length.
For private viewing, many people do. For public posting or business use, use licensed music or tracks the editor can legally provide.
Usually an MP4. Say where it will be shown: TV, projector, social media or a phone, so the size and shape fit.

faq.q: Can text and dates be added?
faq.a: Yes. Send titles, names, dates and captions in a document, with spelling checked.

faq.q: Can old printed photos be used?
faq.a: Yes, if scanned or photographed clearly. Some editors also restore or improve old photos for an extra fee.
